title: Add public Articles section + authenticated My Submissions + clearer submission confirmation

requirements.summary: Add an Articles section with a public list of published articles and an article detail page, reusing existing published story feed/detail data fetching.
acceptanceCriteria: The app has a clearly labeled "Articles" entry in the primary navigation.
The Articles page lists published items returned by the existing published-content API and shows an empty state when none exist.
Clicking an article opens a detail page that renders the full content.
Existing routes for current story pages continue to work (no broken links).

file_operations.description: Register new public routes for the Articles list and Article detail pages (in addition to the existing /stories and /story/$title routes) to ensure existing story routes continue to work.
Add a clearly labeled primary navigation entry for "Articles" that routes to the new Articles list page. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an Articles list page that composes existing UI components and reuses the published stories query (useGetPublishedStories) to render a list, including an empty state when no published items exist. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an Article detail page that loads a single published item via the existing detail query (useGetPublishedStory) and renders the full content, with navigation back to Articles. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an authenticated "My Submissions" page that shows the logged-in user's submissions and their Pending/Published status, updating immediately after submission and when status changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores the submitter Principal for each new submission.
Backend exposes a query method that returns the caller’s submissions with a status field (Pending/Published).
Frontend provides a "My Submissions" page that requires login and shows a clear login prompt if the user is not authenticated.
After submitting an article while logged in, the new submission appears in "My Submissions" with status Pending without needing a page refresh.
When an admin publishes a submission, its status changes to Published in "My Submissions" and it becomes visible on the public Articles page.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook for fetching the caller's submissions (using the existing backend capability for my submissions) and update the submission mutation to invalidate/update the "my submissions" cache so newly submitted items appear without refresh and status changes are reflected. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a "My Submissions" page that requires Internet Identity login: show a clear login call-to-action if unauthenticated, otherwise list submissions with Pending/Published status and basic metadata, composing existing UI components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the "My Submissions" page into the router with a dedicated route so it is navigable from the UI.

Add a navigation entry to reach "My Submissions" (e.g., conditionally shown when authenticated, or always shown with a login prompt on click) while keeping "Articles" in the primary navigation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Improve the post-submit confirmation UI to clarify submissions are not public until published and provide a direct path to "My Submissions" or login.
acceptanceCriteria: The post-submit success message explicitly states that the article will not appear publicly until it is published.
The success screen includes a button/link to "My Submissions" when the user is logged in (and a login call-to-action if not logged in).
The wording is in English and matches the site’s tone (no placeholder text).

file_operations.description: Update the success/confirmation state messaging to explicitly state submissions are not publicly visible until published, and add a "My Submissions" link/button for logged-in users (or a login call-to-action when logged out). Ensure the new action routes to the My Submissions page. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
